English / code: A verified snapshot is also taken automatically every 24 hours. Restoring is done from the server command line (see the Backup guide) with the service stopped.
Somali (current): Koobi la hubiyey ayaa sidoo kale si toos ah loo qaadaa 24 saacadood kasta. Dib-u-soo-celinta waxaa laga sameeyaa serverka (eeg hagaha Kaydinta) iyadoo adeegga la joojiyey.

English / code: Above the approved amount: record the customer's approval of this revision.
Somali (current): Waxay ka badan tahay qadarka la ogolaaday: diiwaangeli ogolaanshaha macmiilka ee isbeddelkan.

English / code: Add this key to your authenticator app:
Add: authorised deductions recovered from staff
Somali (current): Lagu daray: jaridaha la ogolaaday ee laga soo ceshaday shaqaalaha

English / code: Additional charges require your approval. Please keep this slip to collect your device.
Somali (current): Kharashyo dheeraad ah waxay u baahan yihiin ogolaanshahaaga. Fadlan hayso warqaddan si aad aaladdaada u qaadato.

English / code: All methods here are MANUAL entries (staff record what the customer paid). No payment-provider integration is connected: mobile-money and card payments are never confirmed automatically.
Somali (current): Habkan oo dhan waa gelin MANUAL ah (shaqaaluhu wuxuu qoraa wixii macmiilku bixiyey). Wax isku xirka shirkadda lacag-bixinta ma jiro: lacagta mobaylka iyo kaarka si toos ah looma xaqiijiyo.
Qadarka ku hadhay ka dib komishan

English / code: Amounts in each branch currency; totals are never mixed across currencies
Somali (current): Qadarka waa lacagta laan kasta; wadarta lacagaha kala duwan weligood ma isku darsamaan
Warqadda shaqada maalinlaha ah ee Berberka

English / code: Commission basis: net service amount after discounts and refunds, excluding tax and tips. Retained is before rent, utilities and other operating expenses.
Somali (current): Aasaaska komishanka: qadarka saafiga ah ee adeegga ka dib qiimo dhimis iyo soo celin, iyadoo laga reebay canshuurta iyo tip-ka. Ganacsiga ku hadhay waa ka hor kiro, korontada iyo kharashyada kale.

English / code: Company logo (PNG, JPEG or WebP, max 2 MB; wide PNG with transparent or dark background works best)
Somali (current): Summadda shirkadda (PNG, JPEG ama WebP, ugu badnaan 2 MB; PNG ballaaran oo asal hufan ama madow ayaa ugu fiican)

English / code: Company name (shown on receipts, invoices, reports)
Somali (current): Magaca shirkadda (ka muuqda rasiidada, faktuurada, warbixinnada)
Faahfaahinta maalinlaha ah ee shaqaale kasta

English / code: Device inspected and returned to sellable stock
Somali (current): Aaladda waa la baaray waxaana loo celiyey kaydka la iibin karo

English / code: Dispatched: stock is now in transit
Somali (current): Waa la diray: alaabta hadda waa waddada
Iibka elektarooniga iyo hagaajinta oo isku jira

English / code: Email, SMS and WhatsApp are NOT connected.
Somali (current): Iimayl, SMS iyo WhatsApp lama xirin.

English / code: Enter the counted quantity for the items you counted; differences are posted as stock adjustments (large differences need approval).
Somali (current): Geli tirada aad tiriyey alaabta aad tiriyey; farqiyada waxaa loo diiwaangeliyaa hagaajin kayd (farqiyo waaweyn waxay u baahan yihiin ogolaansho).
FAA'IIDADA UGU DAMBAYSA ka dib jarid

English / code: For security you must replace the initial password before you continue.
Somali (current): Amni awgeed waa inaad beddeshaa erayga sirta hore ka hor intaadan sii wadin.

English / code: In-app notifications are fully working. Outbound channels each need a provider account, credentials and a small adapter; delivery status and per-message cost would be recorded below (see docs/INTEGRATIONS.md for costs).
Somali (current): Ogeysiisyada gudaha app-ka si buuxda ayey u shaqeeyaan. Kanaal kasta oo dibadda ah wuxuu u baahan yahay akoon bixiye, aqoonsiyo iyo adaabtar yar; xaaladda gaarsiinta iyo kharashka fariin kasta hoos ayaa lagu diiwaangelin lahaa (eeg docs/COSTS.md).
Laga jaray: alaabta la isticmaalay (kharash adeeg toos ah)

English / code: Memo: advances paid to staff (cash timing, not an expense)
Somali (current): Xusuus: hormarisyada shaqaalaha la siiyey (waqtiga lacagta, ma aha kharash)

English / code: Memo: commission paid out in the period
Memo: tips (not income, not commission base)
Somali (current): Xusuus: tip (ma aha dakhli, ma aha aasaaska komishanka)

English / code: Net profit = net service income - commission - consumables - operating expenses (rent, power, supplies...). Authorised deductions recovered from staff are added in the FINAL line. Advances are cash timing only (not an expense).
Somali (current): Faa'iidada saafiga ah = dakhliga adeegga saafiga ah - komishan - alaabta la isticmaalo - kharashyada shaqada (kiro, koronto, agab...). Jaridaha la ogolaaday ee laga soo ceshaday shaqaalaha waxaa lagu daraa safka UGU HOREEYA. Hormarisyadu waa waqtiga lacagta oo keliya (ma aha kharash).

English / code: Opening balance of each mobile-money / bank account per branch; dashboard balances = opening + confirmed payments − paid expenses.
Somali (current): Hadhaaga furitaanka akoon kasta oo lacag mobayl / bangi ah ee laan kasta; hadhaagga dashboard-ka = furitaan + lacag-bixinaha la xaqiijiyey − kharashyada la bixiyey.
Fadhi taageero oo akhris keliya ah
Isu dheelli tir kuwa la doortay

English / code: Refund = whatever the customer has paid beyond what they still owe. Restocked items return at their original cost. If your role cannot refund, this sends a request to a manager.
Somali (current): Soo celinta = wixii macmiilku bixiyey oo ka badan wixii ay weli lagu leeyihiin. Alaabta dib loo kaydiyo waxay ku soo noqotaa qiimihii asalka ahaa. Haddii doorkaagu soo celin karin, waxaa codsi loo diraa maamulaha.
Sanduuq furan ayaa loo baahan yahay
U baahan sanduuq furan lacagta caddaanka ah

English / code: Scan barcode or type to search
Scan or search to add items
Somali (current): Iskaan ama raadi si aad alaab ugu darto

English / code: Select payments of one method and branch
Somali (current): Dooro lacag-bixinno hal habka iyo hal laan ah

English / code: Serialized devices are received in dispatch order.
Somali (current): Aaladaha leh taxanaha waxaa loo helaa sida loo diray.

English / code: Stock and prices are re-checked now. Leave payment empty to sell on credit (customer required).
Somali (current): Kaydka iyo qiimaha hadda dib ayaa loo hubiyaa. Ka tag lacag-bixinta madhan si deyn loogu iibiyo (macmiil ayaa loo baahan yahay).
Fadhiga taageerada waa bilowday (akhris keliya, 2 saac). Token:

English / code: Take-home = commission earned - advances - authorised deductions (what the employee has earned that day/period after those items). Retained = income after refunds minus commission, before consumables, rent and other expenses.
Somali (current): Qaadashada gurigga = komishanka la kasbaday - hormarisyada - jaridaha la ogolaaday (wixii shaqaaluhu kasbaday maalintaas/muddadaas ka dib waxyaabahaas). Ku hadhay = dakhliga ka dib soo celinta laga jaray komishanka, ka hor alaabta, kirada iyo kharashyada kale.

English / code: Tap a service to add it
Somali (current): Taabo adeeg si aad ugu darto

English / code: The logo appears on the sign-in page, the menu, thermal receipts, A4 invoices, quotations, repair slips, and the header of report print-outs and PDF exports. Each branch can also have its own logo (Organisation → Edit branch); the company logo is used when a branch has none.
Somali (current): Summaddu waxay ka muuqataa bogga gelitaanka, liiska, rasiidada yaryar, faktuurada A4, qiimeynta, warqadaha hagaajinta, iyo madaxa daabacaadaha iyo PDF-yada warbixinnada. Laan kasta waxay yeelan kartaa summaddeeda (Ururka → Wax ka beddel laanta); summadda shirkaddu waxay shaqeysaa marka laantu aanay lahayn.

English / code: The platform operator can only view your data (read-only) while a grant is active. Every request is logged in the audit log. You can revoke at any time.
Somali (current): Hawlwadeenka madashu wuxuu arki karaa xogtaada oo keliya (akhris keliya) inta ogolaanshuhu shaqeynayo. Codsi kasta waxaa lagu diiwaangeliyaa diiwaanka hubinta. Waad joojin kartaa waqti kasta.

English / code: This quotation is not an invoice. Prices and availability are confirmed at sale.
Somali (current): Qiimeyntani ma aha faktuur. Qiimaha iyo helitaanka waa la xaqiijiyaa wakhtiga iibka.

English / code: Uses the latest stored exchange rate on or before the period end. Native-currency totals above remain authoritative.
Somali (current): Waxay isticmaashaa sarifkii ugu dambeeyey ee la keydiyey ilaa dhammaadka muddada. Wadarta lacagaha asalka ah ee kor ku xusan ayaa ah kuwa rasmiga ah.
